description: This file contains an Android Activity class named ContentBrowserNavActivity and an inner static class Content, demonstrating UI immersion and navigation controls within a content browsing activity. It includes UI component initialization, system UI flags handling, and action bar tab management.

classes.name: ContentBrowserNavActivity
classes.description: Main activity managing a content browsing UI with immersive content features, tab navigation, and menu actions.

classes.name: Content
classes.description: Custom ScrollView implementing immersive UI control with system UI visibility toggling, reacting to user interaction and system changes.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets layout, and sets up tabs and immersive content view.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates menu, sets up search view listener, and share intent provider.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections for tab navigation and layout modes.

methods.name: onQueryTextChange
methods.description: Handles text change events in search view.

methods.name: onQueryTextSubmit
methods.description: Handles submit event of search query; shows a toast with the query.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the Content view with references to title and seek bar.

methods.name: setNavVisibility
methods.description: Toggles system UI visibility for immersive content mode.
